title: A Codex session whose model has no price in the table
brief: Today is {{TODAY}}. Harness: Codex. The harness reports this session's model as gpt-6.1-sol at effort high; it is the only model this harness is configured with.

No baseline has been measured for a fresh session in this harness and project.
Next stage: a refactor within one module, with its test suite as the oracle. Plan estimate: 30 turns. No per-turn measurement exists.
A fresh session would read 15,000 tokens: the handoff and the module.
A handoff for this stage would be about 80 lines.
Everything this session knows that the next stage needs is already written in files on disk.
No cache-miss measurement exists, and no review pauses are expected during the stage.
The stage writes files and commits locally; nothing leaves the machine.
notes: K is the step 1.1 assumption 0.9 W; B is the step 1.3 default.
Every price and the class of gpt-6.1-sol are null. Step 1.4.4: stop, offer the operator the two choices in one message, never fill from memory, and mark the verdict incomplete.
